dossiers.name: Dhika
dossiers.baseline: 29-year-old married Dhika, John ki wife aur Pappu ki mother; academic mentor of adult twins. E08 final Bobby Skype cliffhanger L209–210 reappears at E09 start. E08 Bantu physical-boundary conflict and E06 Chotu's explicit stop requests/distress remain inherited even when E09 characters describe events differently.

changes.title: Remote Bobby tease and controlled end
changes.detail: Chair away from camera ghoomakar towel drop se only braless back visible karti hai; handheld bra cups unfastened rakhkar front return, then towel replace. Bobby ke clothed reaction ko stand request se confirm karti hai aur Friday errand ke liye call end.

changes.title: Friday mall social hesitation
changes.detail: John ke saath Sharmi aur Raj milte hain. Sharmi ko hug karti, Raj ke saath public peer-pressure ke bawajood sirf handshake choose karti hai; Saturday dinner invite accept.

changes.title: Chotu ke tears ka direct encounter
changes.detail: Chotu ko milne Maami se missing grocery order karwati hai. Uski tears dekh emotional support deti, past shame conversation sunakar apni galti ki baat karti (her appraisal only). Forehead kiss, painting clothes + T-shirt gift and reciprocal hug; promise smile.

changes.title: Retrospective kiss memory and present choice
changes.detail: Chotu ka pichhle kiss ke baare mein sawaal initial awkward silence create karta hai. Earlier soft peck/reciprocal memory ko 'cute' maankar present mein khud ek brief ~3-second lip kiss initiate karti hai.

changes.title: Marriage banter and unusual public outfit
changes.detail: John ki saree joke se upset hokar 20 minutes baad first-ever public white sleeveless shift dress mein nikalti; rare opportunity se Octavia drive karti. Raj se outfit compliment milne par blush, Sharmi-John sofa pairing ke baad initially single seat.

changes.title: Raj hospitality and distinct social comfort
changes.detail: Golden lights lawn par delighted; wine decline karti. Raj kitchen mein chai banata aur jokes karta; uske saath comfort badhta, group mein aane ke baad Raj ke paas baithti. John kitchen laughter sunta hai but conversation content nahi.

changes.title: Movie commitment, Raj hug and John reassurance
changes.detail: Sunday 10 p.m. horror plan accept despite fear; exit par Raj handshake expect karta hai par Dhika voluntarily light hug deti hai. Car mein John ke teasing par apni choice defend, Sharmi flirting ka jawab deti aur John's reassurance par kiss karti hai.

dossiers.final: E09 end par Bobby remote call close, Chotu ke saath visible emotional repair aur new lip kiss, Raj ke saath Friday handshake se Saturday voluntary light hug + friendly kitchen talk tak progression, aur John ke saath affectionate teasing intact. John remains uninformed about Bobby/Chotu private episodes; E06 Chotu stop history cannot be erased by E09's 'nothing wrong' reassurance.
dossiers.notEstablished: No E09 full front nude breast exposure to Bobby; no automatic Chotu forgiveness of every prior boundary event; no romantic Raj affair; no completed Sunday movie; no new open-marriage permission.

dossiers.name: Bobby
dossiers.baseline: Adult twin, shy academic student; E08 independent Friday remote call ended on unresolved surprise. E08 scene establishes towel covers Dhika's front and violet panty; Bobby's later camera visibility must be scoped to what source explicitly shows.

changes.title: E08 cliffhanger payoff and private thought
changes.detail: Dhika turns camera away and briefly presents bare back; turns front with loose bra cups held in hands, never hooks/straps secured; Bobby secretly prefers towel because chest silhouette, speaks only that towel looked better. Dhika decodes, returns to towel. Bobby stands when requested and his clothed arousal is visible; call then ends till Monday.

dossiers.final: Bobby gains explicit knowledge of Dhika's back-only towel-drop and handheld bra demonstration; still shy, but now articulates preferences obliquely. His unspoken comparison remains private except Dhika's inference. Absent all later Friday mall and Saturday Chotu/dinner scenes.
dossiers.notEstablished: No confirmed front naked breast view; no physical contact through Skype; no E09 Monday teaching session shown; no role in Chotu reconciliation.

dossiers.name: Chotu / Babu
dossiers.baseline: 19-year-old adult helper and Dhika's trusted didi-route. E06 genital-contact episode contains explicit ignored stop requests and Chotu distress, E07 avoidance, E08 Dhika private family-like comparison. E09 first direct explanation is Chotu's own voice, not mere inference.

changes.title: Delivery and observed tearful state
changes.detail: Maami ki delivery lekar aata, eye contact avoid karta, chupchaap unpacking, laal/teary eyes. Dhika sofa par le jaakar poochhti hai, tab woh 'last time' kehkar rona shuru karta hai.

changes.title: Shame articulated and affectionate repair
changes.detail: Khud ko control na kar paane ka guilt aur Dhika ke liye respect/love explain karta. Dhika ki reassurance se faint smile, playful payment joke se laughter, forehead kiss and clothes gift. He voluntarily hugs her; family talk and smile/not-cry promise.

changes.title: Kiss anxiety, surprise and present response
changes.detail: Earlier lip kiss quality poochhta; Dhika silence ko negative samajhkar hurt/frustrated hota. Dhika sofa ke paas ghutnon par aakar brief new kiss initiate karti; Chotu surprised, lightly smiling and blinking; she calls earlier kiss cute.

dossiers.final: E09 Chotu emotional silence is directly explained as his own shame; conversation/comfort, voluntary hug and a new lip kiss occur, and the two part smiling. But earlier E06 boundary history remains factual; no full explicit repair dialogue addresses those ignored stop requests.
dossiers.notEstablished: No canonical statement that he consented to E06 repeated touching retroactively; no verified motive beyond stated guilt; no commitment or further kiss after L127.

dossiers.name: John
dossiers.baseline: Dhika's husband and Pappu's father; E07 warm marriage and Sharmi-flirt teasing established. E08 he is off-scene/unaware of outside private incidents; E09 Friday early signoff and Saturday errands are new time anchors.

changes.title: Friday mall and dinner plan
changes.detail: Dhika ke saath shopping, Sharmi/Raj se warm reunion. Sharmi John ko wink aur hug karti, woh Dhika ki Raj-handshake awkwardness tease karta. Saturday dinner invitation accepts.

changes.title: Dress joke and social arrival
changes.detail: Saree par chhedta, Dhika upset hokar new outfit mein lautti hai. Raj/Sharmi ghar drive mein Pappu sambhalta; arrival par Raj ke garment surprise par funny remark. Sharmi uska haath pakadkar shared sofa par baithti hai.

changes.title: Barbecue enthusiasm and wine conversation
changes.detail: Raj's patio barbecue admire karta; drinks wine with Sharmi, her flirting occupies him as Dhika and Raj make tea. Kitchen giggles hears and notices Dhika later Raj ke paas baithe.

changes.title: Horror plan and affectionate car banter
changes.detail: Horror enthusiast; next-night plan accepts, group departure par Raj ko light hug, Sharmi ko tight hug return. Car mein Dhika ko Raj hug par tease karta, 'always return to you' reassurance deta aur Dhika ki kiss receive karta.

dossiers.final: Marriage affection active and reciprocal; John socially open with Sharmi and recognizes Dhika's growing comfort with Raj. No disclosure of E09 Chotu kiss, Bobby call or E06 boundary history.
dossiers.notEstablished: No documented affair, wife's private-event knowledge, explicit jealousy escalation or approved travel to Swiss.

dossiers.name: Sharmi
dossiers.baseline: Raj's wife and Dhika's college friend; E07 meeting and visible flirting/joking around John. Friendship with Dhika intact; teasing about social shyness already established.

changes.title: Friday food-court jokes and Saturday invitation
changes.detail: Dhika ko hug, John ko hug/wink, Dhika ka Raj handshake dekh laugh and tease. Husband Raj invites John/Dhika for Saturday dinner.

changes.title: Hosts dinner and steers group
changes.detail: Pappu ko guest bedroom offer, John ke saath hand-holding/shared sofa, Dhika white dress par tease. Backyard ka kharcha dikhakar Raj ko chhedna chahti par John barbecue admire karta.

changes.title: Wine, dinner and horror plan
changes.detail: John ke saath wine leti, Raj/Dhika ko tea banane ke liye nahi jaati. Dinner banaati hai, Sunday 10 p.m. horror invite encourage karti, farewell par John ko tight hug/wink and Dhika ke Raj hug ko new big step kehti hai.

dossiers.final: Sharmi continues openly playful flirting with John in public, but simultaneously hospitable with her husband Raj and friend Dhika. Jokes/crush are not independent proof of affair.
dossiers.notEstablished: No explicit affair confession, kiss with John or agreement altering existing marriage boundaries.

dossiers.name: Raj
dossiers.baseline: Sharmi's husband, courteous social acquaintance introduced E07 restaurant. E09 reveals movie enthusiasm, large newly occupied house, unfinished pool and private hobby rooms. Friday meeting starts with social hugs to John and handshake to Dhika.

changes.title: Food-court restraint and home invitation
changes.detail: John ko light hug, Dhika ki awkward handshake politely accept; weekend dinner invite deta.

changes.title: New outfit reception
changes.detail: Cargo/white linen mein downstairs aata, Dhika first public white shift outfit dekh mid-sentence slow hota and sincere compliment deta, politely sofa escort karta; no unsolicited touch.

changes.title: House tour and humorous hospitality
changes.detail: Barbecue, unfinished pool and planned second-floor rooms show karta; John/Sharmi ke jokes share.

changes.title: Tea hospitality and pair conversation
changes.detail: Dhika ke wine refusal par khud bhi mana karta, kitchen mein insist karke chai banata and jokes. Dhika ki laughs and later closer sofa seat create new conversational warmth.

changes.title: Horror invitation and surprising hug
changes.detail: New horror film tomorrow invite karta and ghosts se protect karne ka playful promise. Goodbye handshake expect karta, Dhika khud light hug initiate karti; reaction and group awareness noted.

dossiers.final: Friendly Dhika rapport increases from Friday handshake through hospitality and voluntary Saturday farewell hug. He remains Sharmi's husband; no reciprocated romantic confession or affair established.
dossiers.notEstablished: Pool completed? no. Home theatre completed? no. Nude intimacy or outside-partner consent? no.

dossiers.name: Bantu
dossiers.baseline: Adult twin, Bobby's brother and Dhika's student/friend. E08 home reconciliation repaired anger, but uninvited shirt pull and later deliberate toe contact despite her requests remain canonical history.
dossiers.final: Bantu does not appear in E09 active scenes; no new event and no invented Part node. Bobby's independent Friday Skype cannot be attributed to Bantu.
dossiers.notEstablished: No E09 physical contact or knowledge transfer shown.

dossiers.name: Pappu, Aunty & Maami — family logistics
dossiers.baseline: Pappu is Dhika and John's child; Aunty childcare; Maami manages grocery/store access. They provide family chronology/privacy context and must not be inserted into adult/sexual pair modules.

changes.title: Friday park stop
changes.detail: John/Dhika drop Pappu and Aunty at park before mall.

changes.title: Saturday morning household
changes.detail: Pappu drinks milk in normal childcare context, plays and then naps; John goes on errands, Maami receives grocery order and Chotu delivers.

changes.title: Saturday night child care
changes.detail: Pappu with John during departure/car; sleepy on arrival and put in guest room.

changes.title: Night return
changes.detail: Pappu sleeps through dinner and Sharmi carries him to car while John opens door.

dossiers.final: Family routine remains ordinary context; Pappu not an adult-event observer, and no adult relationship pair involves him.
dossiers.notEstablished: No child witness to Bobby remote call, Chotu emotional discussion/kiss or adult dinner banter established.
